name: kb-rag-research-refusal-calibration-v1
description: 独立拒答阈值校准候选集；证据文档不与 kb-rag-research-dev-v1 的 evaluation gold 重叠。8 条可答题与 4 条高语义相似不可答题，仅用于固定 score source 下的拒答阈值标定。

items.question: Blended RAG 的研究在哪两个信息检索数据集上报告了新的检索 benchmark？

alternatives.quote:
Our study achieves better
retrieval results and sets new benchmarks for IR (Information
Retrieval) datasets like NQ and TREC-COVID datasets.

items.question: Telco-RAG 重点面向哪类电信标准文档？

alternatives.quote:
The paper introduces Telco-
RAG,1 an open-source RAG framework designed to handle
the specific needs of telecommunications standards, particularly
3rd Generation Partnership Project (3GPP) documents.

items.question: Video Enriched RAG 用什么文本机制把视频信息接入聊天助手？

alternatives.quote:
we propose the use of "aligned visual captions" as a
mechanism for integrating information contained within videos
into retrieval augmented generation (RAG) based chat assistant
systems.

items.question: Lion 优化器实验中，哪个模型取得最高 NDCG@10 和 MAP，数值分别是多少？

alternatives.quote:
ModernBERT trained with
Lion achieved the highest NDCG@10 (0.7225) and MAP (0.5121)
on TREC DL 2019, while MiniLM trained with Lion tied with
ModernBERT with Lion on MRR@10 (0.5988) on MS MARCO
dev.

items.question: MusT-RAG 要把通用 LLM 适配到什么任务？

alternatives.quote:
we propose MusT-RAG, a
comprehensive framework based on Retrieval Augmented
Generation (RAG) to adapt general-purpose LLMs for
text-only music question answering (MQA) tasks.

items.question: RankArena 支持哪些评测模式？

alternatives.quote:
RankArena supports multiple
evaluation modes: direct reranking visualisation, blind pairwise
comparisons with human or LLM voting, supervised manual docu-
ment annotation, and end-to-end RAG answer quality assessment.

items.question: DPR 训练时加入多个正例 passage 带来了什么效果和资源收益？

alternatives.quote:
Experimental results show that
equipping each question with multiple positive
passages consistently improves retrieval accu-
racy, even when using a significantly smaller
batch size, which enables training on a single
GPU.

items.question: Guardian Crawler 的 risk-based reranking 在 900 文档合成语料上取得了怎样的 P@10 和 NDCG@10，并如何对比 BM25？

alternatives.quote:
Experiments on
a synthetic 900-document corpus and 10 queries produced the highest descriptive retrieval scores
under risk-based reranking, with P@10 = 1.00 and NDCG@10 = 0.94, compared with 0.94 and
0.81 for BM25.

items.question: Blended RAG 上线后的月度 AWS 账单是多少美元？
Telco-RAG 在运营商生产环境中把网络故障时长降低了百分之多少？
MusT-RAG 在 2028 年格莱美官方投票预测中的准确率是多少？
Guardian Crawler 部署到真实失踪人员网站后，经人工验证的答案忠实率是多少？
